notes.title: My New Game “Monster Mayhem” Launches June 27!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

I’m super excited to announce that my next game, Monster Mayhem, will be launching on June 27 on Steam!

I’ve been working solo on this project for a while now, and if you’ve enjoyed any of my previous games, I think you’ll really enjoy this one too. Monster Mayhem is a fast-paced 2D survivors like game where you fight through waves of monsters, unlock unique heroes, and take down huge bosses – all wrapped in a colorful, cartoonish style.

If you’d like to support a solo dev, the best way is to wishlist the game, it helps a lot with visibility on launch day:
---> https://store.steampowered.com/app/3585220/Monster_Mayhem/

Thanks so much for all the support, it means the world to me. See you June 27!

notes.title: Minor Update
notes.content:
Small update that solves some problems regarding the survival mode Leaderboard.

The Leaderboard has been reset, but at the beginning of the game, your current highscore will automatically be placed in the Leaderboard.

notes.title: Update 1.0.9
notes.content:
Added full controller support. 

 Now you can play the entire game with an x-box one controller.
You can press "G" at any time to switch from keyboard to controller.
For a full overview of the controls, refer to the Controls page in the game. 

 Fixed various minor bugs.

notes.title: Update 1.0.8
notes.content:
Various bug fixes.

Solved problem that causes the player explosion at the start of the mission after the game over.
Solved the problem that causes scrap metal loss when you exit the game.
Solved various minor bugs.
Solved several issues regarding explosions and particle effects.


Various optimizations.

Added current wave in survival mode.
